# Test CrossEntropyMethod.optimize
env = PointEnv(length=200, goal_x=1, goal_y=0, goal_radius=0.1)
optimizer = CrossEntropyMethod(env, horizon=1)

print("Initial probabilities:")
print(optimizer.probs)

# Run optimization
optimizer.optimize(num_samples=100, num_elites=10, iterations=1)

print("\nProbabilities after 1 iteration:")
print(optimizer.probs)

# The optimal action should be action 1 (move right to reach goal at (1,0))
print(f"\nAction 1 probability: {optimizer.probs[0, 1]:.4f}")
